name: @cross-code/nx-ns-app
description: Nx plugin for NativeScript applications — build, test, run, debug, and clean via the NativeScript CLI.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && for d in executors/build executors/test executors/run executors/debug executors/clean executors/prepare generators/init generators/app; do cp src/$d/schema.json $d/schema.json 2>/dev/null; done
